description: Isolated BH; star arrives from ~1e5 AU on a near-parabolic orbit, no other bodies within 0.05 pc
BH-star pair at 14-27 AU for >2 Myr; a MS-MS binary passes at ~3000 AU just before; orbit near e=1 (slightly unbound at trigger)
BH-star pair at 70-85 AU for >2 Myr, no other bodies within 0.05 pc; orbit near e=1 (slightly unbound at trigger)
BH-star wide binary (~350-750 AU) for >2 Myr; eccentricity driven to e~1 by cluster perturbations
Star arrives from far onto a BH-BH binary (20 + 23.5 Msun, ~135 AU)
Star arrives from far; BH has a 6.7+1.6 Msun binary at 600-1000 AU
Star arrives from far onto a BH-MS binary (14.6 + 2.2 Msun, ~200-280 AU)
Hierarchical triple: MS-MS binary (1.12+1.09 Msun) orbiting the BH at ~175 AU for >2.5 Myr; BH disrupts one of the two stars
Hierarchical quadruple: BH-star binary (~65 AU) + MS-MS binary (1.80+0.41 Msun) at ~4400 AU, stable for >2.6 Myr
BH-star binary (7-24 AU) + WD-MS binary (1.21+1.16 Msun); strong encounter, the MS star reaches ~230 AU from the BH just before the TDE
